name: Silver Gelatin Contact Sheet
zh: 银盐接触印相 × 红铅笔暗房手记
summary: 1950s Magnum darkroom proof aesthetic: 310gsm Ilford warm-tone baryta fibre paper (#EFEAD9) on a wet bench, H&D-curve selenium-toned silver tones (#0A0B0E D-max to #9D9E98) with Tri-X 400 halide grain clusters, 35mm sprocket holes and KODAK TRI-X PAN FILM 5063 rebate code, Zone 0–X step wedge and f/8 test strip, crimson/yellow China-marker select boxes, reject crosses and DODGE/BURN notes, and a Schneider 8× loupe with barrel magnification and chromatic aberration. Natively supports 1920×1080 (16:9 contact sheet + 8×10 work print) and 1080×1440 (3:4 film-strip proof board).
